arm_leg_low.feedback: Stretch your arm and leg a little further, towards the level of your back, only as far as feels steady.
arm_leg_low.meaning: your arm and leg did not reach the level of your back

back_sag.feedback: Keep your back flat and your hips level.
back_sag.meaning: your lower back dipped or your hips tilted while you stretched

no_hold.feedback: Hold the stretched position for 2 seconds.
no_hold.meaning: you did not hold the top position

upper_arm_moves.feedback: Keep your upper arms still against your body.
upper_arm_moves.meaning: your upper arm moved away from your side

low_range.feedback: Bend your elbows a little further, bringing your hands towards your shoulders, only as far as is comfortable.
low_range.meaning: the movement did not go as far as the exercise asks

body_swing.feedback: Keep your body still; do not rock back to lift.
body_swing.meaning: you rocked your body back to help lift

low_hips.feedback: Lift your hips a little higher, towards a straight line from shoulders to knees, without pain in your back.
low_hips.meaning: your hips did not lift high enough

over_arch.feedback: Do not push your hips too high; keep your lower back from arching.
over_arch.meaning: your hips went too high, so your lower back arched

feet_far.feedback: Bring your feet closer to your buttocks.
feet_far.meaning: your feet were too far from your buttocks

low_range.feedback: Open your fingers a little wider, only as far as is comfortable.
low_range.meaning: the movement did not go as far as the exercise asks

not_closed.feedback: Between openings, close your hand into a gentle fist.
not_closed.meaning: your hand did not close into a fist between openings

fingers_not_spread.feedback: Spread your fingers wide as you open your hand, only as far as is comfortable.
fingers_not_spread.meaning: your fingers stayed close together when your hand opened

low_raise.feedback: Rise a little higher onto your toes, holding the chair, only as far as feels steady.
low_raise.meaning: your heels did not rise high enough

knees_bend.feedback: Keep your knees straight as you rise.
knees_bend.meaning: your knees bent as you rose onto your toes

leaning_forward.feedback: Rise straight up, keeping a light hold on the chair rather than leaning on it.
leaning_forward.meaning: you leaned your upper body forwards

trunk_lean.feedback: Keep your body upright; do not lean away from the lifting leg.
trunk_lean.meaning: your body leaned to the side

low_range.feedback: Keep holding the chair and lift your leg a little further out to the side, only as far as is comfortable.
low_range.meaning: the movement did not go as far as the exercise asks

leg_forward.feedback: Lift the leg straight out to the side, not forwards.
leg_forward.meaning: your leg went forwards instead of straight out to the side

bent_knee.feedback: Keep the knee of the lifting leg straight.
bent_knee.meaning: the knee of your lifting leg was bent

toes_up.meaning: your toes turned up or outwards as the leg lifted

incomplete_extension.feedback: Straighten your knee so your leg is straight out in front, as far as is comfortable.
incomplete_extension.meaning: your knee did not straighten fully

slouching.feedback: Sit up straight with your back against the chair.
slouching.meaning: you slumped or leaned back away from the chair back

thigh_lift.feedback: Keep your thigh resting on the seat; only the lower leg moves.
thigh_lift.meaning: your whole thigh lifted off the seat

no_hold.feedback: Hold the straight leg for 2 seconds before lowering it.
no_hold.meaning: you did not hold the top position

leaning_forward.feedback: Keep your upper body upright; do not lean towards your knee.
leaning_forward.meaning: you leaned your upper body forwards

low_knee_lift.feedback: Lift your knees a little higher, only as far as is comfortable.
low_knee_lift.meaning: your knees did not lift high enough

leaning_back.feedback: Stand tall; do not lean backwards.
leaning_back.meaning: you leaned your upper body backwards

no_arm_swing.feedback: If you feel steady, swing your arms as you march. If not, keep one hand on the chair.
no_arm_swing.meaning: your arms stayed still while you marched

too_deep.feedback: Only bend your knees a little, about a third of the way down.
too_deep.meaning: you bent your knees further than a mini squat

heels_lift.feedback: Keep your heels on the floor.
heels_lift.meaning: your heels came off the floor

trunk_forward.meaning: you bent forward at the waist

low_knee_lift.feedback: Lift your knees a little higher, only as far as is comfortable.
low_knee_lift.meaning: your knees did not lift high enough

leaning_back.feedback: Sit upright; do not lean back against the chair.
leaning_back.meaning: you leaned your upper body backwards

using_hands.feedback: Lift your legs without pulling them up with your hands.
using_hands.meaning: your hands pulled your leg up

low_range.feedback: Raise your arms a little higher, towards shoulder height, only as far as is comfortable.
low_range.meaning: the movement did not go as far as the exercise asks

bent_elbow.feedback: Keep your elbows straight as you lift.
bent_elbow.meaning: your elbows were bent while your arms were raised

uneven_arms.feedback: Lift both arms together to the same height.
uneven_arms.meaning: one arm went higher than the other

trunk_lean.feedback: Keep your body upright; do not lean to the side.
trunk_lean.meaning: your body leaned to the side

shoulder_shrug.feedback: Relax your shoulders down, away from your ears.
shoulder_shrug.meaning: your shoulders lifted up towards your ears

head_tilt.feedback: Keep your head level and look straight ahead as you lift.
head_tilt.meaning: your head tilted to one side as you lifted

low_range.feedback: Raise your arms a little higher, towards shoulder height, only as far as is comfortable.
low_range.meaning: the movement did not go as far as the exercise asks

bent_elbow.feedback: Keep your elbows straight as you lift.
bent_elbow.meaning: your elbows were bent while your arms were raised

back_arch.feedback: Keep your back still; do not lean backwards as your arms go up.
back_arch.meaning: your lower back bent backwards as your arms went up

swinging.feedback: Lift slowly and pause at the top instead of swinging.
swinging.meaning: you swung your arms up quickly instead of lifting slowly

trunk_forward.feedback: Stand tall; do not bend forward at the waist.
trunk_forward.meaning: you bent forward at the waist

shoulder_shrug.feedback: Relax your shoulders down, away from your ears.
shoulder_shrug.meaning: your shoulders lifted up towards your ears

hands_used.feedback: If you can, stand up with your arms crossed. If you need your hands to stand safely, that is fine: keep using them.
hands_used.meaning: your hands pushed on your legs or the chair to help you stand

incomplete_stand.feedback: Stand up fully: straighten your hips and knees at the top, as far as you safely can.
incomplete_stand.meaning: you did not stand up fully straight at the top

no_forward_lean.feedback: Lean your chest forward a little before you stand up.
no_forward_lean.meaning: you did not lean your chest forward before standing up

uncontrolled_sit.feedback: Sit down slowly: reach back for the chair with your hands and lower yourself gently.
uncontrolled_sit.meaning: you sat down too quickly instead of lowering yourself slowly

feet_forward.feedback: Bring your feet back so your knees are above your ankles before you stand.
feet_forward.meaning: your feet were too far in front of you when you started to stand

trunk_forward.feedback: Keep your chest up as you step.
trunk_forward.meaning: you bent forward at the waist

knee_not_straight.feedback: Straighten your leading leg at the top, holding the rail, as far as is comfortable.
knee_not_straight.meaning: your leading leg was not fully straight at the top of the step

drop_down.feedback: Step down slowly, holding the rail, and let your foot touch down gently.
drop_down.meaning: you came down from the step too quickly

feet_not_in_line.feedback: Place one foot directly in front of the other, heel touching toe.
feet_not_in_line.meaning: your feet were side by side or apart instead of one in front of the other

stepping_out.feedback: If you wobble, step out or hold the counter: that is the safe thing to do. With practice you will hold it for longer.
stepping_out.meaning: you stepped out of position during the hold

leaning.feedback: Stand upright with a light touch on the counter, rather than leaning your weight on it or to the side.
leaning.meaning: you leaned on the counter or to the side

hips_sag.feedback: Keep your body straight; do not let your hips drop towards the wall.
hips_sag.meaning: your hips dropped towards the wall, so your body was not straight

hips_back.feedback: Keep your body straight; do not push your hips back.
hips_back.meaning: your hips were pushed back, so your body bent at the hips

low_range.feedback: Bend your elbows a little more to bring your chest closer to the wall, only as far as is comfortable.
low_range.meaning: the movement did not go as far as the exercise asks

low_range.feedback: Lift your hand a little higher, only as far as is comfortable, keeping your forearm resting on the table.
low_range.meaning: the movement did not go as far as the exercise asks
